lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 5 distinct vertical white line segments traversing the torso; spacing is non-uniform, with increased distance between the 4th and 5th posterior segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st anterior line is truncated and does not reach the mid-lateral point; the 3rd line displays a discontinuity near the dorsal crest.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low density; two isolated high-contrast white spots visible on the posterior flank and upper hind limb region.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate spiral geometry; horns extend posterodorsally with a lateral flare before curving inward toward the apical tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated pixel distance between terminal tips is 1.8x the width of an individual horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 0.12 of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Dual white spots in the infraorbital region; tan 'socks' on all four limbs distal to the carpus/tarsus; prominent dark ventral fringe extending from neck to groin.
